package main

func labelled(n int) int {
	s := 0
outer:
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		for j := 0; j < n; j++ {
			if j == 3 {
				continue outer
			}
			if i*j > 20 {
				break outer
			}
			if j%2 == 0 {
				continue
			}
			s += i * j
		}
	}
	return s
}

func fallthroughs(x int) int {
	r := 0
	switch x {
	case 1:
		r = 10
		fallthrough
	case 2:
		r += 2
	case 3, 4:
		if r == 0 {
			break
		}
		r = 30
	default:
		r = -1
	}
	return r
}

func recovers() (r int) {
	defer func() {
		if e := recover(); e != nil {
			r = 7
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		if i == 5 {
			panic("boom")
		}
		r += i
	}
	return r
}

func short(a, b, c bool, x int) int {
	if a && (b || c) {
		x++
	}
	if !a || b && x > 3 {
		x--
	}
	for x > 0 && !c {
		x -= 2
	}
	return x
}

func selects(a, b chan int, quit chan bool) int {
	n := 0
	for {
		select {
		case v := <-a:
			n += v
		case v, ok := <-b:
			if !ok {
				return n
			}
			n -= v
		case <-quit:
			return n
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	println(labelled(10), fallthroughs(1), recovers(), short(true, false, true, 2))
	a, b, q := make(chan int), make(chan int), make(chan bool)
	go func() { a <- 1; b <- 2; close(b) }()
	println(selects(a, b, q))
}
